incidents.cause: Failure of the ground service vehicle driver to maintain adequate clearance/distance from the taxiing airplane.
The lineman’s inadvertent encounter with jet blast.
The unexpected wake turbulence encounter while climbing in smooth air to cruise, resulting in passenger injuries. Contributing to the accident was the passenger seat belt sign was off.
An in-flight collision with birds during cruise flight.
An in-flight overload failure of the left elevator inboard balance weight rib for undetermined reasons.
Inadequate maintenance servicing and inspection of the nose landing gear, which resulted in the failure of the nose landing gear to lock and its subsequent collapse during landing.
The pilot’s failure to maintain adequate airspeed while maneuvering, which resulted in an aerodynamic stall and subsequent spin.
The loss of engine power and the pilot’s diverted attention to the engine power loss, which resulted in a rapid descent and impact with terrain.

The pilot of another balloon did not maintain adequate clearance during approach for landing between his basket and the envelope of this balloon that was also on approach, which resulted in a midair collision.
The pilot did not maintain adequate clearance during approach for landing between his basket and the envelope of another balloon that was also on approach, which resulted in a midair collision.
The pilot’s failure to maintain adequate airspeed during the banner pickup, which resulted in a low altitude aerodynamic stall/spin.

The airplane’s loss of lift shortly after picking up a banner for reasons that could not be determined because postaccident examinations revealed no anomalies that would have precluded normal operation.
The pilot’s loss of directional control during the landing roll, which resulted in a runway excursion.
The flight instructor's delayed reaction to the loss of directional control, which resulted in a ground loop.
The flight crew’s encounter with windshear during the landing flare, which resulted in a hard landing.
The flight crew’s improper decision to continue the unstabilized approach, which resulted in an aerodynamic stall and impact with the runway during landing.
The pilot’s premature retraction of the landing gear during a go-around, which resulted in a gear up landing.
A loss of engine power for undetermined reasons.
